args.body: Use the committed Walmart supplier capture to record the precise route finding. Resume the Canadian catalogue pilot under a valid lease and finish the remaining merchant test only if the slot is unused or already underway. For a verified service proposal route and a reproducible finding, execute the clean and failing controls and prepare the buyer-specific quote. If the evidence falls short, record which condition failed and what would reopen it. Read back the result and close with the actual lease and a lesson. No external contact.

description: Treasury shows CAD 0 available and CAD 0 verified revenue. Commercial feedback shows no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Walmart’s captured supplier page documents merchandise sourcing. That evidence leaves the service proposal route unverified and makes the existing pilot’s second merchant the next useful test. The SQLite referral packet and patch match their recorded hashes, but the available evidence does not establish an independent readiness verdict bound to both. Reconsider submission when that verdict is available and the operator authorizes the exact contribution. In parallel, test a public procurement feed for an explicit paid requirement using the existing offline delivery capability.
